job.resolved_prompt:
### Use case(s) - what problem will this feature solve?

In some cases we want to retry connections more aggressively compared to the default behavior (e.g. for health checkers in tests in order to detect that server is up faster).

### Proposed Solution

Add tunable parameters as described in the [documentation](https://github.com/grpc/grpc/blob/master/doc/connection-backoff.md).

It can be done by extending `grpc.BackoffConfig` struct (and therefore is not a breaking change).

/bin/zsh -lc "git show 31911ed0:backoff.go 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,130p'; git show 31911ed0:internal/backoff/backoff.go 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,130p'; git show 31911ed0:dialoptions.go 2>/dev/null | rg -n -C 8 \"WithConnectParams|WithBackoffConfig\""

/bin/zsh -lc 'git cat-file -p 31911ed0 | head -20; git show 31911ed0''^:backoff.go 2>&1 | head -100; git remote -v'

/bin/zsh -lc "git ls-tree -r --name-only 31911ed0 | rg '("'^|/)(backoff|connect|dialoptions).*'"\\.go"'$|backoff'"'; git show 31911ed0:backoff.go | sed -n '1,160p'; git show 31911ed0:internal/backoff/backoff.go | sed -n '1,160p'; git show 31911ed0:dialoptions.go | rg -n -C 12 'ConnectParams|BackoffConfig'"
/bin/zsh -lc "git fsck --no-reflogs --unreachable 2>/dev/null | head -50; git log --all --oneline -- backoff/backoff.go | head -20; git log --all --oneline --grep='BackoffConfig' | head -30"
/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files internal/backoff | sort; rg -n \"backoff.Exponential\" --glob '*.go' | head -80; git show 31911ed0:backoff/backoff.go 2>&1 | head -120"
